texts.facts: This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/ A-12, seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.48 of 2018 of Dowleswaram Police Station, East Godavari District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 270 and 273 I.P.C and Section 5 and 22 of Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition, Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003.
